questions.question: Anupam Mittal stayed unmarried for over a decade after launching his matchmaking website, remaining too engaged in growing the business to tie the knot himself. What was the platform originally called when he launched it in 1997?
questions.fact: In 2012, parodying Angry Birds, Shaadi.com launched a viral Facebook game called Angry Brides to protest dowry harassment.

questions.question: Before Sachin and Binny Bansal turned their startup into an e-commerce giant that flipped the Indian retail market on its head, they launched it out of a Bengaluru apartment in 2007 selling only one specific category of cart-worthy items. What was the first product category Flipkart sold?
questions.fact: They were ex Amazon employees. Inspired by Amazon's early playbook, they started exclusively with books.

questions.question: STAR Plus entered India as an English channel, while _____ served as its Hindi counterpart under the same satellite banner. After the two split in 2000, Star Plus pivoted entirely to Hindi programming—launching blockbuster hits like Kaun Banega Crorepati.
questions.fact: In July 2000, a struggling Star Plus bet everything on a pure-Hindi rebrand and a nearly bankrupt Amitabh Bachchan hosting Kaun Banega Crorepati, shattering Indian TRP records and making it the #1 channel overnight.

questions.question: After being denied entry into a five-star hotel for wearing a traditional dhoti, founder K. R. Nagarajan decided to rebrand the humble veshti as a symbol of prestige rather than rural wear, launching the iconic _____ campaign in 2001.
questions.fact: The company originally launched as Ramraj Khadi Traders. Four years later, in 1987, Nagarajan pivoted to fine cotton fabrics and rebranded to Ramraj Cotton.

questions.question: Before delivering millions of meals across India, Sriharsha Majety, Nandan Reddy, and Rahul Jaimini incorporated their logistics venture in 2013 under a corporate name that sounded like a slang for bluff. What was Swiggy's original registered company name?
questions.fact: In 2013, BITS Pilani alumni Sriharsha Majety and Nandan Reddy (along with Rahul Jaimini) initially launched Bundl, an e-commerce logistics platform designed to bundle up and ship products for small local businesses.

questions.question: Long before it became a global IT powerhouse, this company spent its early decades cooking up business in Amalner, Maharashtra, by manufacturing vanaspati and cooking oils. a slippery start that eventually refined its way into technology. Which IT giant started out as Western India Vegetable Products Limited?
questions.fact: Incorporated in 1945 by Mohamed Hasham Premji as Western India Vegetable Products Limited, the company originally manufactured sunflower vanaspati oil and laundry soap in Amalner, Maharashtra.

questions.question: Long before private news channels and streaming apps took over, millions of Indians tuned into Doordarshan every week to watch their favorite shows. But before the program began, viewers were transfixed by a mesmerizing, hypnotically rotating geometric logo accompanied by an iconic, flute-heavy instrumental tune composed by Pandit Ravi Shankar. What was this legendary visual landmark affectionately known as?
questions.fact: When India's national broadcaster first launched as an experimental pilot project in Delhi on September 15, 1959, it didn't even have its own dedicated building or budget. It was operated out of a makeshift studio under All India Radio using equipment gifted by UNESCO and a foreign electronics firm.
